resources.string: Lets the red button on Prime\'s home screen end your Grok Bot call.

What this does: when you tap the red hang-up button on the Beacon home screen, Prime opens Grok Bot\'s call screen and taps Grok Bot\'s own End call button for you, then returns to the home screen.\n\nWhat it can see: only Grok Bot\'s screens (no other app). It acts only in the 5 seconds after you tap the hang-up button, and only clicks that one button. It never reads or saves anything on screen, types nothing, makes no gestures, and doesn\'t watch your keys.

Lets Prime see the screen and tap, swipe and type while Phone Link is connected. Distinct from the hang-up helper. Off until you turn it on. Factory-reset, root and recovery screens are always refused. Disconnect any time from the Prime link notification, the Quick Settings tile, or Settings.
